On each turn, the agent replays the full sequence of update_booking calls from the beginning of the conversation (e.g. Turn 10 makes 8 update_booking calls to reconstruct state). This is an LLM context/checkpointing behavior issue — not user-facing but increases latency and token cost significantly.

notes: Scenario ran cleanly. The off-topic price tangent was handled — bot answered and returned to booking context. The main gap vs expected behavior is that after the tangent, the bot did not re-pose the pending audience question explicitly; it relied on the user to proactively re-anchor. In real conversation with a less cooperative user, this could cause the flow to stall. A slot-collision race occurred on Turn 9 (10:00 slot taken concurrently); bot recovered gracefully with alternatives.
